violations.why: The ISR can overwrite v_tundra with &v_kelp between the task's write and its read, so the task dereferences a different pointer than it set.
The ISR can change v_tundra between the task's two reads, so the second read sees a different pointer from the first.
v_timber and v_indigo both point to v_vessel. The ISR can read it through v_timber between the task's two writes and see the intermediate value 2.
